evidence: GUGiK's collective EGiB WFS (mapy.geoportal.gov.pl/wss/service/PZGIK/EGIB/WFS/UslugaZbiorcza), announced on geoportal.gov.pl on 2026-07-16, serves cadastral parcels (ms:dzialki, ID_DZIALKI TERYT identifiers) gathered from the county EGiB WFS services listed in EZiUDP.
Its parcel identifiers equal ULDK's TERYT parcel IDs for the same parcels (probed in eleven cities on 2026-10-12).
